g.text: Power declarations: USB-C supplies 5V and GND;

g.desc: Power declarations: USB-C supplies 5V and GND;

g.text: GPIO_VREF is supplied through the fitted H2 shunt (default 2-3).

g.desc: GPIO_VREF is supplied through the fitted H2 shunt (default 2-3).

g.text: USB0 connector-local ESD (separate from USB3 RX)

g.desc: USB0 connector-local ESD (separate from USB3 RX)

g.text: H2: fit shunt 2-3 for default 3.3V; 1-2 selects 1.8V. Power OFF before changing.

g.desc: H2: fit shunt 2-3 for default 3.3V; 1-2 selects 1.8V. Power OFF before changing.

g.text: GPIO bank follows VREF; header 3.3V pins remain 3.3V.

g.desc: GPIO bank follows VREF; header 3.3V pins remain 3.3V.

g.text: MIPI1 / HAT I2C follows GPIO_VREF; verify peripherals in 1.8V mode.
